rightsReview.reason: Independent through-service partner Yokohama Minatomirai Railway publishes the current stop diagram. Its policy reserves copyrighted prose, pictures, diagrams and tables; retain only independently structured minimum F-liner calling facts, source fingerprints and attribution, not the diagram or timetable. Current departure page explicitly identifies Tobu Tojo F-liner as rapid express. Only green F-marked calls within Tobu physical section are extracted; unclassified gray ordinary rows are not interpreted. Tobu website restricted material is not the source of these facts.
